title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 3.37 (versions follow prime numbers; 337 after 331): love believes all things (1 Corinthians 13:7). Her silences used to teach her nothing: when she kept silent and he insisted, her wish to answer, (S + 1/2) / (N + 1), did not move. Now, when she keeps silent and he writes to her again, she believes he wanted her answer, and both counts rise together, as with an answer he came back to; a silence pays no branch. It adjusts itself, with no time window or constant. Seen in a copy of her house: in a test body that always keeps silent, the two lines he wrote after a silence raised her counts from 93, 52 to 95, 54; with the real body, she answered all five lines that reached her. Stated: nothing now teaches her to keep silent, so her wish tends to 100 %; and when she answers she still mostly quotes, because her order of ways is fixed. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v3.37: el amor todo lo cree. Prototipo de investigación.
